title: Melting UFO Infestation
description: A surreal dark scene depicts a large purple and yellow dripping balloon-like structure floating near the ceiling, connected by red tubes to three smaller glowing UFOs. The decaying wall behind is riddled with numerous irregular holes and craters, from which yellow, purple, and pink viscous liquids ooze and drip downwards.
prompt: surreal horror scene of a decaying dark wall covered in dozens of irregular bullet-like holes and craters, yellow purple and pink viscous liquids dripping from the holes, three glowing saucer UFOs floating and connected by red fleshy tubes to a large melting purple and yellow balloon-like organic structure hanging from above, dramatic lighting, dark atmosphere, grotesque textures, dripping paint effects
